scientificBoundaries: This remains an illustrative fictional two-species model, not a Galapagos reconstruction or empirical forecast.
Arrival counts describe movement. Transmitted copies measure contribution to this newborn cohort; those quantities have different units.
An arriving organism may leave zero or multiple copies. A transmitted letter may already occur locally.
Birth-round parent location and a copy’s G0 origin describe different time scales. Earlier immigrant ancestry can persist without current arrivals.
H = 2p(1-p) describes one neutral two-letter marker. It is not an observed heterozygote fraction or genome-wide diversity.
Opening routes changes the parent pool; the paired outcomes also include parent and allele sampling. One draw is not a guaranteed effect or a unique causal decomposition.
G0 has no recorded dispersal/birth round, so its arrival/transmission observations are undefined rather than invented.
Stored drafts preserve bounded text and valid case settings. Worlds, outcomes and ancestry are recomputed from the original seed and boat draw.
Notes may discuss several cases; the journal and export explicitly identify the currently recorded case.
